description: Internal and external HTTP probes for published route liveness verification

requirements.title: Internal probe per route
requirements.description: For each enabled route in the manifest, HTTP GET the local port (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:36238/). Any response with status < 500 counts as alive. Configurable timeout (default 5s).

requirements.title: External probe per route
requirements.description: For each enabled route, HTTP GET the public URL (e.g., https://agent-manager.itsagitime.com/). Any response with status < 500 counts as reachable. Configurable timeout (default 10s).

requirements.title: Probe result classification
requirements.description: Classify each route's status based on probe results: up (both pass), tunnel-issue (internal passes, external fails), scenario-down (internal fails), unknown (both fail). Persist results with timestamps.

requirements.title: Concurrent probe execution
requirements.description: Run probes concurrently (bounded goroutine pool) to avoid slow routes blocking the entire probe cycle. Configurable concurrency limit (default 5).

requirements.title: Periodic probe scheduling
requirements.description: Run full probe cycle on a configurable interval (default 60s). Store probe history for trend display.

requirements.title: Custom health endpoint support
requirements.description: Route manifest entries can specify a custom health path (e.g., '/health' or '/api/health'). If specified, probes use that path instead of '/'. This enables more reliable health detection.
